tasks.subject: Task 1: PyInstaller onedir démona
tasks.description:
**Goal:** packaging/build-daemon.sh zbuildi sysmon-app-daemon jako onedir se zabudovanym Vite buildem. Vychozi rezim buildi v debian:13 kontejneru (portabilni artefakt), --host dela nativni build pro Arch.

**Files:**
- packaging/requirements-build.txt
- packaging/Dockerfile.daemon
- packaging/build-daemon.sh
- .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- vychozi build skonci 0 a vytvori packaging/daemon/sysmon-app-daemon + _internal
- binarka z vychoziho buildu bezi v debian:13 bez Pythonu a obslouzi /stats
- --host zbuildi nativni variantu, ktera bezi na Archu
- bez sysmon_app/web/index.html skonci 2 s ceskou vetou
- bez Dockeru skonci vychozi rezim 2 s nabidkou --host
- packaging/.venv, packaging/build, packaging/daemon, packaging/daemon-build nejsou v gitu

**Verify:** build + curl na 18430 + Docker bez Pythonu + --host build


tasks.subject: Task 2: Bundled démon, bundle config a migrace autostartu
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Obal najde zabaleneho demona relativne ke sve binarce, tauri.conf umi bundling a instalovana aplikace tise prepsise zastaraly autostart.

**Files:**
- src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
- src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs
- src-tauri/src/autostart.rs
- src-tauri/src/main.rs
- packaging/sysmon-app.desktop.template

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- cargo test projde; nove testy pinuji hledani bundled demona i should_rewrite
- cargo build --release projde
- z cargo run se stale spousti python3 -m sysmon_app
- ze simulovaneho instalovaneho stromu se spusti bundled demon a /stats odpovi
- existujici .desktop s vyvojovou cestou se z instalovane cesty prepsise; z target/ ne
- tauri.conf ma productName sysmon-app, bundle.active true, targets deb/rpm/appimage a resources na packaging/daemon

**Verify:** cargo test + cargo build --release + simulovany instalovany strom + prepis .desktop

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src-tauri/tauri.conf.json", "src-tauri/src/sidecar.rs", "src-tauri/src/autostart.rs", "src-tauri/src/main.rs", "packaging/sysmon-app.desktop.template"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test + cargo build --release + simulovany instalovany strom + prepis .desktop", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cargo test projde; nove testy pinuji hledani bundled demona i should_rewrite", "cargo build --release projde", "z cargo run se stale spousti python3 -m sysmon_app", "ze simulovaneho instalovaneho stromu se spusti bundled demon a /stats odpovi", "existujici .desktop s vyvojovou cestou se z instalovane cesty prepsise; z target/ ne", "tauri.conf ma productName sysmon-app, bundle.active true, targets deb/rpm/appimage a resources na packaging/daemon"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Instalátory a kontejnerové ověření
tasks.description:
**Goal:** cargo tauri build vyrobi .deb, .rpm a AppImage; .deb a .rpm se nainstaluji v cistych kontejnerech a jejich demon tam bezi.

**Files:**
- packaging/verify-package.sh
- src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (jen pri potrebe opravy resources nebo zavislosti)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- cargo tauri build --bundles deb,rpm,appimage projde
- .deb se nainstaluje v debian:13; existuje binarka, bundled demon, desktop s Name=Sysmon a ikona
- .rpm se nainstaluje ve fedora:42 se stejnou kontrolou
- demon z nainstalovaneho balicku odpovi na /stats v obou kontejnerech
- AppImage po --appimage-extract obsahuje stejny strom a Name=Sysmon
- packaging/verify-package.sh je spustitelny a umi deb i rpm

**Verify:** cargo tauri build + packaging/verify-package.sh deb ... + packaging/verify-package.sh rpm ... + AppImage extract

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packaging/verify-package.sh", "src-tauri/tauri.conf.json"], "verifyCommand": "cargo tauri build + verify-package.sh deb/rpm + AppImage extract", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cargo tauri build --bundles deb,rpm,appimage projde", ".deb se nainstaluje v debian:13; existuje binarka, bundled demon, desktop s Name=Sysmon a ikona", ".rpm se nainstaluje ve fedora:42 se stejnou kontrolou", "demon z nainstalovaneho balicku odpovi na /stats v obou kontejnerech", "AppImage po --appimage-extract obsahuje stejny strom a Name=Sysmon", "packaging/verify-package.sh je spustitelny a umi deb i rpm"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: PKGBUILD
tasks.description:
**Goal:** packaging/arch/PKGBUILD zbuildi a zabali stejny instalovany layout nativne pro Arch.

**Files:**
- packaging/arch/PKGBUILD
- packaging/sysmon-app.desktop
- .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- makepkg -f v packaging/arch vyrobi sysmon-app-0.1.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
- balicek obsahuje /usr/bin/sysmon-app, /usr/lib/sysmon-app/daemon/sysmon-app-daemon (+ _internal), desktop a obe ikony
- demon z rozbaleneho balicku odpovi na /stats
- depends obsahuji webkit2gtk-4.1 a gtk3
- build neinstaluje nic do systemu

**Verify:** makepkg -f + bsdtar -tf + spusteni demona z fake rootu

```json:metadata
{"files": ["packaging/arch/PKGBUILD", "packaging/sysmon-app.desktop", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "makepkg -f + bsdtar -tf + spusteni demona z fake rootu", "acceptanceCriteria": ["makepkg -f v packaging/arch vyrobi sysmon-app-0.1.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst", "balicek obsahuje /usr/bin/sysmon-app, /usr/lib/sysmon-app/daemon/sysmon-app-daemon (+ _internal), desktop a obe ikony", "demon z rozbaleneho balicku odpovi na /stats", "depends obsahuji webkit2gtk-4.1 a gtk3", "build neinstaluje nic do systemu"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Měření paměti, README a end-to-end
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Zmerit pamet okna 60 min v realnem okne, zapsat cisla a dokoncit dokumentaci i zaverecne overeni.

**Files:**
- tools/__init__.py
- tools/measure_memory.py
- tests/test_measure_memory.py
- README.md
- docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-17-faze-4-baleni.md

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- python3 tools/measure_memory.py --help projde bez nestandardni knihovny
- python3 -m unittest tests.test_measure_memory -v projde; testy pinuji trend, mediany a klasifikaci
- 60minutove mereni v realnem okne splni web slope <= 5 MB/h a delta <= 15 MB
- namerena cisla jsou v planu a README
- README popisuje instalaci, AppImage prerekvizitu, PKGBUILD, minimalni glibc a mereni pameti
- cela Python sada projde (156 + nove testy)
- cargo test a npm run typecheck projdou; ../sysmon je cisty

**Verify:** unit testy + 60minutovy beh + README prikazy doslova + regresni sada
